## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature or improvement.

## Problem / Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? What is the user scenario?
(e.g., "I want to be able to route desktop audio to multiple virtual devices simultaneously...")

## Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
Describe how you envision this feature working from a user and/or technical perspective.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, CoreAudio considerations, or links here.
